title: Speculative Decoding for Semantic-ID-Based Generative Recommendations
abstract: arXiv:2611.32855v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommender systems with Semantic IDs (SIDs) represent each item as a short sequence of $L$ discrete tokens and use a sequence model to predict the next item's tokens from a user's history. Industry-scale deployments typically use these models to retrieve multiple candidates per request with constrained beam search. However, this incurs a fixed cost of $L$ sequential model calls per request, and accuracy degrades as the SID generator becomes less sharp, without a guarantee on how close the output is to the exact top-$K$. Production systems therefore cannot detect degraded retrieval for individual requests.   We propose SIDECAR, which uses approximate draft candidates and a tree-attention pass to score the entire draft in a single model call, memory permitting. This pass bounds the probability of every unexplored SID prefix and certifies the exact top-$K$ if the draft contains them. Otherwise, a branch-and-bound fallback expand

translated_title: 面向基于语义ID的生成式推荐的投机解码
translated_abstract: 采用语义ID（SID）的生成式推荐系统将每个物品表示为一个由 $L$ 个离散词元组成的短序列，并利用序列模型根据用户历史预测下一个物品的词元。工业级部署通常使用此类模型，通过受限束搜索为每个请求检索多个候选物品。然而，这会带来每请求 $L$ 次顺序模型调用的固定开销，且当SID生成器的分布变得不够尖锐时准确率会下降，同时无法保证输出与精确top-$K$结果的接近程度。因此，生产系统无法检测到单个请求层面的检索质量退化。我们提出SIDECAR，它利用近似的草稿候选和一次树注意力机制，在内存允许的情况下通过单次模型调用对整个草稿进行打分。这一过程为每个未探索的SID前缀的概率设定上界，并在草稿包含精确top-$K$结果时对其进行认证。否则，则回退到分支定界策略进行扩展……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: SIDECAR通过近似的草稿候选与树注意力机制，在单次模型调用中对整个草稿打分，从而在认证精确top-$K$检索结果的同时，大幅降低基于语义ID的生成式推荐的推理开销。
en_tdlr: SIDECAR accelerates Semantic-ID-based generative recommendation by scoring approximate draft candidates in a single tree-attention model call, certifying exact top-K retrieval while substantially reducing inference cost.
